zh.title: 國防部偵獲中共19機艦船活動 6架次共機逾越中線
zh.summary: 國防部表示，自8月6日上午6時至8月7日上午6時止，共偵獲中共機艦船合計19單位在台海周邊活動，包含中共軍機10架次、軍艦6艘及公務船3艘。其中有6架次軍機逾越海峽中線，進入台灣中部及西南空域。國軍運用任務機艦與岸置飛彈系統進行嚴密監控與應處。
body: 根據國防部公布資訊，自8月6日上午6時至8月7日上午6時止，國軍共偵獲中共機艦船合計19單位在台海周邊活動。統計內容包括中共軍機10架次、軍艦6艘以及公務船3艘。
國防部示意圖顯示，國軍於6日上午6時20分至晚間7時10分在台灣海峽空域偵獲7架次主戰機、直升機及無人機，其中3架次逾越中線。另於6日上午8時20分至晚間7時15分在海峽中線以東的西南空域，偵獲3架次輔戰機及直升機。
總計有6架次軍機逾越海峽中線進入中部及西南空域。針對中共機艦船在台海周邊的活動，國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統進行嚴密監控與應處。

en.title: Taiwan Detects 19 PLA Aircraft and Vessels as 6 Sorties Cross Median Line
en.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense announced that 19 Chinese military aircraft, naval vessels, and official ships were detected operating around the Taiwan Strait between 06:00 on August 6 and 06:00 on August 7. The recorded sorties included 10 PLA aircraft, 6 PLA Navy vessels, and 3 official ships. Among the detected aircraft, 6 sorties crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait, entering central and southwestern airspace. Taiwan's armed forces monitored the activities and responded using combat air patrol aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems.
body: According to data released by Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense, a total of 19 Chinese military aircraft, naval vessels, and official ships were detected operating around the Taiwan Strait between 06:00 on August 6 and 06:00 on August 7. The recorded assets comprised 10 PLA aircraft, 6 naval vessels, and 3 official ships.

The ministry's flight activity diagram indicated that between 06:20 and 19:10 on August 6, 7 sorties of main combat aircraft, helicopters, and unmanned aerial vehicles were detected in the Taiwan Strait, with 3 crossing the median line. Additionally, 3 auxiliary aircraft and helicopter sorties were detected in the southwestern airspace between 08:20 and 19:15.

In total, 6 PLA aircraft sorties crossed the median line into central and southwestern airspace. Taiwan's armed forces monitored and responded to the situation using task force aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems.
